abstract: A possible relationship between the development of granulated metrial gland (GMG) cells and trophoblast was studied. Trophoblast implanted in ectopic sites (e.g. kidney capsule) did not induce decidua and did not recruit GMG cells. Only when injected in utero did trophoblast lead to the development of decidua and to the recruitment of GMG cells. With malignant trophoblast (choriocarcinoma cells) similar results were obtained as with normal trophoblast both after ectopic or after in utero injection. The presence of decidua, but not the development of a conceptus or the outgrowth of trophoblast, seems to be required for the differentiation of GMG cells.
abstract_ja: 正常および悪性の栄養膜細胞と、顆粒状子宮間質(GMG)細胞の発生との関係を検討した。異所性部位(腎被膜など)に移植した栄養膜細胞は脱落膜もGMG細胞も誘導しなかった。子宮内に注入した場合にのみ、栄養膜細胞は脱落膜の発生とGMG細胞の誘導につながった。悪性栄養膜細胞(絨毛癌細胞)でも、異所性および子宮内注入のいずれにおいても、正常栄養膜細胞と同様の結果が得られた。GMG細胞の分化には、脱落膜の存在が必要と考えられ、胎芽の発生や栄養膜細胞の増殖そのものは必要ではないと思われる。
